marketing_description: The DeWALT DCG422B Right Angle Die Grinder is a cordless tool featuring a brushless motor and equipped with the DEWALT anti-rotation system for control. It has a slim, ergonomic design and includes an LED Worklight to illuminate dark work areas, as well as a speed selector button for variable speed control. The tool also features an electronic brake designed to stop the wheel in less than 1 second.
